title: Bombay plague epidemic
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bombay plague epidemic", at revision 1382475509, opens: "The Bombay plague epidemic was a bubonic plague epidemic that struck the city of Bombay in British India in the late nineteenth century. The plague killed thousands, and many fled the city, leading to a drastic fall in the population of the city. In September 1896, Bombay's municipal administration declared the presence of bubonic plague in the city. The administration of ineffective protocols furthered the spread. By January 1897, half the population fled to the countryside." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4940602, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Bubonic plague epidemic in Bombay, India". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
